analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time, supported by capacity expansion and a strategic shift towards value-added coated steel products. The company commissioned its new Alu-Zinc coating line (1,10,200 TPA) and augmented its existing colour-coated line capacity to 60,000 TPA during the year. Management highlighted strong operating leverage, improving capital efficiency, and a debt-light balance sheet with no long-term debt. For FY 2026-27, the company expects to achieve consolidated revenues of INR 1,500 Crore, backed by the ongoing expansion of colour-coated steel capacity to 1,50,000 TPA. Manaksia Steels Limited is undergoing a significant transformation by expanding its manufacturing capacities through two capital expenditure programs focused on value-added flat metal products like Alu-Zinc and colour-coated coils and sheets.

guidance.claim: The first expansion programme would result in consolidated annual revenues of 1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The second expansion investment is expected to generate annual revenue of 500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of 40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Realisation and EBITDA margins weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales tonnage increased 15% during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of volumes, the Company’s sales tonnage increased 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company will introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.
management_commitments.quote: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
